site.name: 3Deca
site.description: Sturdy carbon/nylon set gear for production sound mixers: mounts, belt clips and storage caddies for Zaxcom, Sennheiser and Wisycom. Designed and used on set.

intro.title: Built on set. For the set.
intro.lead: I'm a production sound mixer based in Europe. We made these items because we felt we needed them on the set. I use them daily, and so do my colleagues.
intro.hero_alt: Eight Zaxcom ZMT transmitters lined up in a black 3D-printed storage box on a warm wooden table, antennas raised.

values.title: Sturdy carbon / nylon
values.text: Printed from carbon-reinforced nylon. No flimsy stuff: these parts live on belts, carts and car dashboards.

values.title: Designed by a working mixer
values.text: Every piece started as a problem on a real set. If it didn't make the job easier, it didn't make the cut.

values.title: Made to fit your kit
values.text: Need a different bay count, battery type or a fit for your case? Ask, and I'll build it.

ordering.title: How ordering works
points: For now, orders go via the order form or by email only.
Prices are ex VAT. Contact me for a commercial invoice.
Questions or suggestions? Contact me any time.

products.name: ZMT Mount
products.tagline: Put your plant mic exactly where you want it.
products.summary: A holder that mounts a Zaxcom ZMT transmitter to a tripod, clamp, grip head, magic arm, superclamp or any metal surface.
features: Strong magnet on the back, rubber-coated so it won't scratch
Two standard 3/8" threads, on the back and on the bottom
Flexible mounting options to place your mic exactly where you want it
Great for car mounts
Snug fit: hangs upside down without dropping the transmitter

products.name: Battery Belt Clip
products.card_name: Belt clip for NP-50 / LBP61 and AA batteries
products.fits: 2× NP-50 or Wisycom LBP61 + 3 or 4 AA
products.tagline: I'm sure you've wished you had this on your belt. Many times.
products.summary: A belt clip that carries two NP-50 or Wisycom LBP61 batteries plus 3 or 4 AA batteries, always within reach.
features: Easy access with one hand
Strong spring-loaded belt clip
Extra mounting hole to hang tape or accessories
Custom holders possible (for example 4× NP-50)
products.note: Please specify NP-50 or LBP61, and 3 or 4 AA, when you order.

reviews.quote: Hey, package received, I love 'em! Thanks a lot! Cheers
reviews.name: Till Röllinghoff

reviews.quote: It's a very well-thought-out bit of kit and clearly coming from someone with experience on set with very specific things he needed to make things easier. My favourite bit so far is the threaded ZMT mount with a magnetic back. Works very well for sticking it to the ceiling and doors for plant mics. Love the threaded hole for connecting it to different types of arms. The magnet is really strong. No flimsy stuff. Also one of the cleanest 3D print finishes I've seen so far.
reviews.name: Sãm Kashefi

reviews.quote: These are amazing! The rubber on the magnet is such a nice touch. I'll be putting them to good use ASAP. Thanks again!
